title: primula lactea
intro: Primula lactea, commonly known as White Marsh Marigold, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Primulaceae family. It is native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia, where it grows in damp, grassy areas. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of colds, fever, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Primula lactea, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-oxidative and anti-inflammatory effects.
